babs.1: The one prevented, and the compensation for game
babs.4: One who said the prevented person owes no replacement
babs.5: The saying of Allah the Exalted: "Whoever of you is ill or has an ailment of the head …"
babs.6: The saying of Allah the Exalted: "or charity", which is feeding six poor people
babs.7: The feeding in the ransom is half a ṣāʿ
babs.9: The saying of Allah the Exalted: "Then no sexual relations"
babs.10: The saying of Allah: "… and no wickedness and no quarrelling during Hajj"
